lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of circular high-luminance pixel clusters are visible across the lateral flank. The median row contains at least six well-defined nodes with higher intensity than surrounding tissue, showing a regular spacing that diminishes in interval toward the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of spots to form a rectilinear grid pattern, particularly prominent in the mid-lateral region posterior to the gills.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the dorsal flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and localized shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high-density stippled pattern of small, high-luminance pixel clusters, which are significantly smaller and more numerous than the primary flank constellations.
